lines.text: Every file on TrenchMart is checked before anyone can buy it.
Upload a script, and its hash is pinned the moment it lands.
A static scan and a sandboxed run go first. Then a rules engine and an LLM give their verdict, live.
lines.say: A static scan and a sandboxed run go first. Then a rules engine and an L L M give their verdict, live.

lines.text: When they disagree, the stricter verdict wins. The model can only make it stricter.
Every listing has a signed scan report. Check it yourself on /verify.
lines.say: Every listing has a signed scan report. Check it yourself on slash verify.
